transport_policy: GET/HEAD with canonical QNC URI, authorization, single HTTP byte ranges and explicit version/identity/stamp headers for storage-side Local/LAN/Intranet byte access. HTTPS required outside loopback. No redirect, retry, local fallback or full-file staging.
codec_bridge_policy: Decoder process input uses an owner-produced CodecEndpoint. For FFmpeg this must be a seekable file endpoint from a local or mounted Local/LAN/Intranet binding. A session-private loopback TCP byte stream is allowed only for decoder adapters that explicitly declare support for that process channel and its seek behavior. It is not a storage endpoint, carries no HTTP headers or credentials, and is never a public media identity.
read_policy: Byte access only. Media format and project policy come from separate saved-input modules. File length/mtime checks are storage integrity checks, never media probing. Per-read memory is bounded; runtime hosting, TLS and connection limits belong to the storage host.
